integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the canonical-dual scaling criterion and exact diagonal identities. Supplementary code checks representative exact identities but is not used as a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to real normalized Hadamard bases and positive diagonal operators. The proof uses the flat coordinate moduli essentially. The full theorem body of the 2024 dual-scalability paper was not materially inspected, so an equivalent result hidden there remains a residual literature risk.
title: Canonical-dual scalability phase diagram for diagonal Hadamard pairs
